verdict.rationale: Several independent community reports show GitLab itself being self-hosted. Users describe running their own instance from the open-source core, running a private instance at work, running GitLab in a VM via a TurnKey appliance, and operating a self-managed GitLab EE installation. Missing for 10: first-party installation/self-managed documentation in the evidence pack, and detail on which features are available in the self-hosted open-source core versus paid tiers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: A user values that GitLab is open source at its core, so anyone can run their own instance or fork it if the company moves in a direction the community dislikes.
uses a private instance at work
A self-managed GitLab EE user said backups broke starting in 8.15
